name: A Little More Myself
thesis: An intimate aubergine personal portrait: one sweeping mixed-type name, a full-size SERV0, and a quiet letter that opens into machines, software, and people.
interaction: A keyboard-accessible comparison slider peels a precise vertical section between the actual aligned SERV0 renders, revealing its internals; editorial anchors carry the story through the full page.
why: Combines the loved type-and-object relationship with purple warmth and a personal letter, while giving real space to Stardance software, Outpost support, One Stone teaching, and VEX shop leadership.
